# Installing the Northwind Router

The Northwind R400 ships with firmware 4.2. Unpack the unit, connect the WAN port
to your modem, and power it on. The status LED turns solid green when the router
has an internet connection.

## Requirements

The setup assistant runs in a browser and requires port 8443 to be reachable on
the local network. Administration is not available over the WAN port.

## First login

The default administrator name is `admin`. The initial password is printed on the
label underneath the unit. The assistant forces you to change it before anything
else can be configured.
